en: 2. Khandhayamaka 2.1 Paṇṇattivāra 2.1.1. Paṇṇattivāra-uddesa (Summary of the Section on Designations)
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.
The five aggregates: the aggregate of form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, and the aggregate of consciousness. 2.1.1.1.
Section on the Purification of Terms.
2.1.1.1.1. Positive Order:
Is matter the aggregate of matter?
Is the aggregate of matter matter?
Is feeling the aggregate of feeling?
Is the aggregate of feeling feeling?
Is perception the aggregate of perception?
Is the aggregate of perception perception?
Are formations the aggregate of formations?
Is the aggregate of formations formations?
Is consciousness the aggregate of consciousness?
Is the aggregate of consciousness consciousness?
2.1.1.1.2. Negative (Paccanīka)
Is it not form, yet not the aggregate of form?
Is it not the aggregate of form, yet not form?
Is it not feeling, yet not the aggregate of feeling?
Is it not the case that feeling is not the aggregate of feeling?
Is it not the case that perception is not the aggregate of perception? Is it not the case that the aggregate of perception is not perception?
Are they not formations, yet not the aggregate of formations?
Is it not the aggregate of formations, yet not formations?
Is it not consciousness, yet not the aggregate of consciousness?
Is it not the consciousness aggregate, yet not consciousness?
